scope: post-CLOSE queue-admission push correction; controlled peer wire regressions plus two native 25-leaf runs

manifest.cephfs_mutations: owned Go, recovery, native and push-native LibCephFS identities, three directories with their files, one user xattr and two native writes removed through Go requests and verified natively; one native rename, one snapshot and one quota created and removed natively; the owned daemon's mds_min_caps_per_client and mds_max_caps_per_client lowered and restored, and one cache drop; one owned client eviction and one owned rank-0 MDS restart whose blocklist entries are removed and verified during cleanup
manifest.topology: 3 MON, 0/2 MGR, one OSD and one active rank 0 MDS with an owned filesystem plus a native oracle client

pending_flock.Observation: same-session ordered requests and local wait expiry; no direct native wait-queue observation

interrupt_flock.Observation: same-session ordered barrier, local wait expiry, explicit interrupt and original acquire replies; no direct native wait-queue observation

limitations: The queue-backpressure/CLOSE sequence race is forced with a controlled peer, not an actual native daemon.
Native runs verify the ordinary CephFS push/recovery/metadata family on the changed source; they do not establish every queue-race interleaving.
Local validation and earlier baseline CI are not complete CI at the resulting commit.
